tools.name: results_check_production
tools.title: Check a production-replay run
tools.description: Check a production-replay run: achieved load against the plan, and the think-time verdict.

run_id.description: The run: its handle (e-1a2b3c4d) from run_test or process_get_status, or its UUID; default: the last run of this workspace.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: results_compare_runs
tools.title: Compare two runs
tools.description: Compare two runs metric by metric; compare_to=baseline uses the pinned baseline.

run_id.description: The run: its handle (e-1a2b3c4d) from run_test or process_get_status, or its UUID; default: the last run of this workspace.

compare_to.description: The run to compare with (handle or UUID), or "baseline" for the pinned baseline of this run; default: the choice of this workspace.

include.description: "errors": the console errors only in one run and in both.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: results_export_report
tools.title: Export the Gatling report of a run
tools.description: Export the archived Gatling HTML report to a local folder and return its path.

run_id.description: The run, as a handle (e-xxxxxxxx) or UUID; default: the run of this workspace.

overwrite.description: true: replace a report of this run exported earlier; without it an existing folder is refused.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: results_get_logs
tools.title: Get the log lines of a run
tools.description: Get Gatling log lines of a run (masked, truncated).

run_id.description: The run, as a handle (e-xxxxxxxx) or UUID; default: the run of this workspace.

level.description: Only lines of this level: error, warn, info or debug.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: results_get_request
tools.title: Get one request of a run
tools.description: Get one request's metrics and latency percentiles in a run.

run_id.description: The run: its handle (e-1a2b3c4d) from run_test or process_get_status, or its UUID; default: the last run of this workspace.

request.description: The request as the run names it (POST /checkout), as results_get_report lists it.

include.description: "series": the request over time, at the step of the run; without it, totals only.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: results_set_baseline
tools.title: Set a run as the baseline for its scenario and environment pair
tools.description: Set a run as the baseline for its scenario and environment pair.

run_id.description: The run: its handle (e-1a2b3c4d) from run_test or process_get_status, or its UUID; default: the last run of this workspace.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.
